race.comment: LANTA (4) finished behind LORD MOMO last time out but gets a weight swing in her favour, as well as a better gate out in trip today. The inside barrier is a big tick for his chances and he should get every chance in running. Looks well placed to turn the tables. LORD MOMO (2) made it back-to-back wins last time out when a 1.3L victor over the 1617m journey. Out to this trip for the first time, though it doesn't look a hindrance and he can bring up the hat-trick without surprise. GAV HAS SPOKEN (10) brings solid form from out of a Bunbury CL3, where she was second after covering ground. She gets a much better set-up this time from an inside draw and she can put her best foot forward. SAINTY CULLITY (6) was below expectations last start but was steadied near the 200m and had charged home well here two runs back. Can feature. ALOTTA FIGHTING (8) is not to be discounted.
